comparison_policy: Compare each declared projection exactly; order-sensitive projections preserve event order. Apply no implicit normalization.

selectors.projection: Fully qualified ASGI-dispatch exception class and exact str(exception), or null values when dispatch returns without raising.
Boolean indicating whether the declared AnyIO cancellation scope interrupted the ASGI HTTP dispatch before it returned.
Ordered ASGI send message type names emitted during one HTTP action.
Ordered lifespan application exceptions by stage, fully qualified class, and exact exception message.
Ordered ASGI lifespan receive/send event types across startup and shutdown.
Exact shutdown outcome, response type, and message, including whether shutdown was sent.
Exact startup outcome, response type, and message.
Ordered callback-side effects explicitly recorded by the independent workload and observed after cleanup.
Fully qualified exception class raised during app construction, or null on success.
Exact str(exception) raised during app construction, or null on success; traceback text is excluded.
Whether per-case FastAPI app construction completed or raised an exception.
Ordered labels emitted by dependency call hooks in the independent workload.
Ordered labels emitted when yield dependencies and cleanup hooks finish.
Raw body bytes returned by the selected documentation endpoint.
Ordered ASGI response header byte pairs from the selected documentation endpoint.
ASGI HTTP response status from the selected documentation endpoint.
Exception args as an ordered JSON-safe value sequence.
Exception class module and qualified name.
Explicitly selected public exception attribute names and their recursively JSON-safe values captured during an ASGI dispatch.
Concatenated raw ASGI HTTP response body bytes.
Response JSON parsed without field filtering; pair with http.body.bytes when wire representation matters.
Ordered cookie records derived from Set-Cookie response headers, including attributes.
Boolean absence of the named lower-case response header.
Ordered ASGI response header byte pairs, retaining duplicate names and values.
ASGI HTTP response status code.
Explicitly selected side effects emitted during lifespan shutdown and cleanup.
Ordered ASGI lifespan startup, request, shutdown, and cleanup events.
Full app.openapi() JSON value; use selected JSON pointers for focused cases.
OpenAPI paths JSON values with array order preserved; the HTTP body byte selector covers wire representation.
Request-body schema values at explicitly selected OpenAPI JSON pointers.
Security requirements and schemes at explicitly selected OpenAPI JSON pointers.
Process return code after the documented command completes.
Raw standard-error bytes emitted by the documented command.
Raw standard-output bytes emitted by the documented command.

Direct public callable return values or public attribute values as typed JSON-safe data; workflow v1 requires strict JSON, while workflow v2 preserves non-finite float leaves from callable returns with an optional RFC 6901 pointer/value sidecar and null placeholders.
Whether a direct public callable returned or raised; a raised outcome includes the fully qualified exception class and exact message.
Importable module path and bound public symbol name.
Identity relation between explicitly selected public aliases, evaluated with Python `is`.
Ordered callable parameters with names, kinds, defaults, annotations, and return annotation.
Ordered warning records from each selected construction or direct-call phase, retaining fully qualified category class, exact message, stable repository/package-relative filename, and line number.
Explicitly selected background-task effects emitted in execution order.
Matched route identity and extracted path parameters for the request.

Fully qualified exception class raised during the selected ASGI dispatch; response-validation cases use it to identify FastAPI's validation exception, and null records that dispatch returned without raising.

Ordered Pydantic validation error records returned by exception.errors(), including location, type, message, and input/context when present; tuples become arrays, bytes use base64 objects, nested exceptions use qualified class/message objects, and non-finite floats use tagged objects.
Ordered ASGI action warning records with fully qualified category, exact message, stable repository/package-relative filename, and line number.
Final WebSocket close code.
JSON-compatible reason value on the final websocket.close ASGI message, or null when absent.
Ordered independent-workload side-effect labels recorded during WebSocket application dispatch.
Ordered ASGI WebSocket receive and send message types.
Ordered WebSocket text or binary payloads with their message types.
